{{Quote|I am a contract worker hired by Colonel Teraud to keep expanding this facility&hellip; which is crazy given how big it is already.|Phy Hudgen|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Phy Hudgen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial worker|contract worker]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Hudgen was hired by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Bors Teraud]] for the purpose of expanding the [[The Warren (Dantooine)|The Warren]], an Imperial Research Facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. However, chaos erupted, forcing Hudgen to hole up in one of the facility's rooms. He eventually encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was tasked by the Empire to investigate the situation.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Phy Hudgen was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
